capabilities: adds Play buttons to shell code blocks
starts commands without opening a terminal window
extras: Desktop-only (Windows, macOS, Linux). Supports German and English interfaces.
problem: Developers need a way to execute and monitor package scripts and shell commands without leaving the Obsidian environment or opening external terminal windows.
summary: Dev Runner allows users to execute package scripts and shell commands directly from Obsidian, managing processes and capturing output in a dedicated sidebar.
